description: This file defines classes, structs, enums, and functions related to push notification registration and relay management, including handling challenges, attestation, receipt management, and network requests to a push relay service.

classes.name: PushRelayReceiptRefreshCoordinator
classes.description: Coordinates receipt refresh requests using StoreKit and handles delegate callbacks.

classes.name: PushRelayAppAttestService
classes.description: Provides methods for creating attestation proofs and assertions using Apple's DeviceCheck framework.

classes.name: PushRelayReceiptProvider
classes.description: Handles loading and refreshing of the app store receipt.

classes.name: PushRelayClient
classes.description: Main class for interacting with the push relay API, including registration and challenge fetching.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Performs push registration by obtaining a challenge, creating attestations, loading receipts, and sending registration request.

methods.name: fetchChallenge
methods.description: Fetches a new registration challenge from the relay server.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes JSON data into the specified Decodable type.
